remarks: Welcome to your dream retreat! This expansive 6,981 square foot home is the perfect short-term rental, offering a magnificent primary suite plus 4 spacious en-suite bedrooms. Entertain in style with large, elegant public rooms and a gourmet kitchen that will delight any chef. Work from home in the impressive wood paneled private office. Play or work out in the finished basement complete with a full bath and second office. Cozy up on the screened-in porch or step outside to enjoy beautifully designed outdoor spaces plus a pool, ideal for relaxing or hosting gatherings under the stars. Conveniently located near top-rated schools, vibrant town life, and accessible transportation, this home combines luxury and practicality. Perfect for anyone seeking a refined, comfortable stay. Don't miss out on this exceptional rental opportunity! Available beginning September 1st for 6 or 7 months.
